items.title: Brightwater orders 40 electric buses for its city routes
items.description: Brightwater council has signed a contract for 40 electric buses, which will replace the diesel fleet on every city route by next spring.

items.title: Electric buses coming to Brightwater after council vote
items.description: Councillors in Brightwater voted to buy electric buses and to build two charging depots, with the first vehicles due in the spring.

items.title: Brightwater commande quarante bus électriques pour ses lignes urbaines
items.description: La municipalité de Brightwater a signé un contrat pour quarante bus électriques qui remplaceront la flotte diesel sur toutes les lignes de la ville dès le printemps.

items.title: Halvorsen Bridge reopens after two years of repairs
items.description: The Halvorsen Bridge carried its first lorries this morning, two years after engineers closed it to traffic over cracks in the main span.

items.title: El puente Halvorsen reabre tras dos años de reparaciones
items.description: El puente Halvorsen volvió a recibir camiones esta mañana, dos años después de que los ingenieros lo cerraran al tráfico por grietas en el tramo principal.

items.title: Halvorsen Bridge open again
items.description: Traffic crosses the Halvorsen Bridge again today after repairs that took two years, and local engineers say the span is now sound and safe.

items.title: Kestrel Orbital launches its first rocket from the north coast
items.description: Kestrel Orbital put its first rocket into the air from the north coast on Tuesday, and the company says the test reached its planned height.

items.title: Kestrel Orbital lance sa première fusée depuis la côte nord
items.description: Kestrel Orbital a lancé mardi sa première fusée depuis la côte nord, et l'entreprise affirme que l'essai a atteint l'altitude prévue.

items.title: Kestrel Orbital test flight goes to plan
items.description: Kestrel Orbital says its first test flight reached the planned height on Tuesday after a short delay for weather, and the crew checks the data.

items.title: Tidewick Lighthouse reopens to visitors after a long restoration
items.description: Visitors can climb the Tidewick Lighthouse again from Saturday, after volunteers spent three years restoring the lamp room and the stairs.

items.title: El Festival de Marmolar abre su programa de otoño con música en la plaza
items.description: El pueblo de Marmolar celebra desde hoy su festival de otoño, con conciertos en la plaza mayor, mercado de artesanía y cenas populares hasta el domingo.
